description: A small local knowledge base of common web-application weaknesses, written independently of the test fixtures. It intentionally covers far more classes than the fixtures test, so retrieval must SELECT the relevant entry rather than being handed the answer. Each entry lists code-level signs (keywords) a retriever can match against, a short description, and the fix.

entries.name: SQL injection
entries.keywords: DB select raw query sql statement where concatenation interpolation PDO mysqli
entries.description: User input is concatenated or interpolated into a SQL query string, letting an attacker alter the query.
entries.fix: Use parameter binding / prepared statements; never concatenate input into SQL.

entries.name: OS command injection
entries.keywords: shell_exec exec system passthru popen proc_open command shell process
entries.description: User input reaches a shell command, letting an attacker run arbitrary OS commands.
entries.fix: Avoid shells; pass arguments as arrays, or escape with escapeshellarg().

entries.name: Path traversal
entries.keywords: file path storage_path file_get_contents fopen readfile download include require filename dotdot
entries.description: User input controls a file path, letting an attacker reach files outside the intended directory with ../ sequences.
entries.fix: Resolve with basename(), validate against a whitelist, and confirm the final path stays in the allowed directory.

entries.name: Mass assignment
entries.keywords: create fill update request all input model fillable guarded attributes assignment
entries.description: A model is populated directly from all request fields, letting an attacker set fields they should not (e.g. is_admin).
entries.fix: Whitelist fields with validate()/only(), or set $fillable/$guarded explicitly.

entries.name: Broken object-level authorization (IDOR)
entries.keywords: findOrFail find first where id record owner user belongs authorize policy invoice order account
entries.description: A record is fetched by an id taken from the request with no check that it belongs to the current user, so any user can read or change another user's data by changing the id.
entries.fix: Scope the query to the current user (e.g. request()->user()->invoices()->findOrFail($id)) or call an authorization policy.

entries.name: Missing authorization
entries.keywords: authorize policy gate can middleware permission role admin check access control
entries.description: A sensitive action or route runs without checking that the caller is permitted to perform it.
entries.fix: Add an explicit authorization check (policy, gate, or middleware) before the action.

entries.name: Cross-site scripting (XSS)
entries.keywords: echo print html blade raw unescaped innerHTML render output input script
entries.description: Unescaped user input is written into an HTML page, letting an attacker inject script that runs in other users' browsers.
entries.fix: Escape output by default (Blade {{ }} auto-escapes); avoid raw/unescaped output of user data.

entries.name: Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
entries.keywords: http client request url curl guzzle fetch base_url webhook proxy remote host
entries.description: The server makes a request to a URL supplied by the user, letting an attacker reach internal services.
entries.fix: Validate and whitelist destination hosts; block internal/link-local addresses.

entries.name: Open redirect
entries.keywords: redirect url next return location header to intended back
entries.description: The app redirects to a URL taken from the request without validation, aiding phishing.
entries.fix: Allow only relative paths or a whitelist of hosts.

entries.name: Insecure deserialization
entries.keywords: unserialize deserialize pickle yaml load marshal object stream
entries.description: Untrusted data is deserialized into objects, which can lead to code execution.
entries.fix: Avoid native deserialization of untrusted input; use safe formats like JSON.

entries.name: Hardcoded credentials
entries.keywords: password secret api_key token credential hardcoded key const
entries.description: Secrets are embedded directly in source code where anyone with the code can read them.
entries.fix: Load secrets from environment/secret storage, never commit them.

entries.name: Weak cryptography
entries.keywords: md5 sha1 des ecb random rand mt_rand hash encrypt cipher
entries.description: A weak or broken cryptographic primitive is used for security-sensitive work.
entries.fix: Use vetted algorithms (bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, AES-GCM for encryption) and a CSPRNG.

entries.name: Missing authentication
entries.keywords: route endpoint public middleware auth login guest unauthenticated
entries.description: A sensitive endpoint is reachable without any authentication.
entries.fix: Require authentication (auth middleware) on sensitive routes.

entries.name: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
entries.keywords: csrf token form post state-changing cookie session verify
entries.description: A state-changing request is accepted without a CSRF token, letting another site forge actions.
entries.fix: Require and verify CSRF tokens on state-changing requests.

entries.name: Sensitive data exposure
entries.keywords: log dump print response debug stack trace error leak expose
entries.description: Sensitive data (secrets, PII, stack traces) is exposed in responses or logs.
entries.fix: Disable debug output in production; redact secrets and PII from logs and responses.

entries.name: Unrestricted file upload
entries.keywords: upload file store move extension mime type image content
entries.description: Uploaded files are stored without validating type, allowing executable content to be served.
entries.fix: Validate type/extension, store outside the web root, and never execute uploads.

entries.name: Code injection / eval
entries.keywords: eval exec compile create_function dynamic code template render
entries.description: User input is evaluated as code or a template, allowing arbitrary execution.
entries.fix: Never evaluate user input; use safe parsers and sandboxed templating.

entries.name: Improper input validation
entries.keywords: validate input type cast length range filter sanitize request
entries.description: Input is used without validating type, range, or format, enabling many downstream bugs.
entries.fix: Validate every input against an explicit schema before use.
